guide.headline: Learn what ProPeloton Manager offers before you join.
guide.intro: ProPeloton Manager is built around long-term cycling management. The public pages explain the game, but the homepage also gives visitors a direct overview of the main systems: team building, rider development, race preparation, tactics, finances, support and season rankings.
guide.title: How ProPeloton Manager works
guide.subtitle: Build the club behind the riders and make the decisions that shape every season.
guide.whatText: ProPeloton Manager is an online cycling management game where you create and develop a cycling club. Instead of controlling a rider directly, you manage the team behind the race: riders, training, race plans, staff, equipment, finances, sponsors, transfers and long-term ranking progress.
guide.howText: Managers build a squad, study the race calendar, apply for suitable races, prepare race plans, choose riders, assign roles, manage supplies and follow results. Good decisions depend on rider skills, fatigue, morale, race profile, weather, budget and season goals.
guide.preparationText: A strong rider is not enough by itself. Race preparation connects riders, staff, vehicles, equipment, supplies and tactics. Planning ahead helps your team arrive ready for sprints, climbs, time trials, stage races and difficult weather conditions.

why.title: More than race day.
why.subtitle: Run the whole cycling world — from the first junior training session to a championship finish.

management.title: Deep team management
management.description: Control decisions across your entire club.
management.details: Assign rider roles, manage fitness and morale, and balance long-term squad building with each race. Training, staff, equipment and finances all affect your decisions.

squads.title: Senior, U23 & youth squads
squads.description: Build a pathway from academy to pro racing.
squads.details: Manage your senior roster while developing U23 and younger talent. Build a long-term path from the youth academy toward the first team.

staff.title: 11 active staff roles
staff.details: Hire specialists in coaching, scouting, medical care, nutrition and mechanics. Their expertise supports rider development, race preparation and recovery.

training.title: Precision training
training.description: Target nine skills with individual plans.
training.details: Set rider-specific training priorities across nine skills. Balance workload, fatigue and potential instead of giving every rider the same routine.

growth.title: Rider development
growth.description: Follow potential, form and long-term growth.
growth.details: Follow changes in rider skills, form, morale, fitness and potential over time. Choose when to specialise, recover or adapt a rider's role.

calendar.title: 593 dated races
calendar.details: Choose from 593 currently dated races, including one-day events and stage races. Plan entries, rest days and squad availability over the season.

preparation.title: Detailed race preparation
preparation.description: Select lineups, tactics and equipment setups.
preparation.details: Choose your starters and leaders, define tactical roles and match equipment to the course. Consider terrain, fitness and race supplies before the start.

tiers.title: Four competition tiers
tiers.description: Compete in regional divisions and rise.
tiers.details: Compete across four tiers divided into leagues, divisions and regions. Fight for better rankings and promotion while protecting your place in the competition.

equipment.title: 170 equipment models
equipment.description: Six gear categories plus race supplies.
equipment.details: Choose frames, wheelsets, tyres, groupsets, helmets and shoes from 170 active models. Manage wear and maintenance alongside consumable race supplies.

assets.title: Infrastructure & race assets
assets.description: Upgrade facilities, team cars and vans.
assets.details: Invest in club facilities, team cars and equipment vans. Better infrastructure and race support can improve logistics and team readiness.

finance.title: Realistic club finances
finance.description: Manage salaries, expenses, taxes and rewards.
finance.details: Manage sponsor income, staff salaries, transfers, equipment, operating costs and taxes. Every investment competes for the same club budget.

sponsors.title: Regional sponsorship engine
sponsors.details: Seek sponsors matched to your club and region, with objectives linked to relevant team competitions. Sponsor deals add income and sporting expectations.

operations.title: Policies & operations
operations.description: Set housing, nutrition, recovery and logistics.
operations.details: Set policies for housing, nutrition, recovery and logistics. Weigh their ongoing costs against the support and bonuses they provide to the club.

transfers.title: Club deals & free agents
transfers.description: Build your squad through both transfer paths.
transfers.details: Negotiate rider moves between clubs or search the free-agent market. Build a balanced roster without losing control of wages and transfer spending.

national.title: National associations
national.details: Take part in national associations and national-team competitions. Prepare national squads for championships alongside your club responsibilities.

academy.title: Youth academy & races
academy.description: Develop young talent from the first step.
academy.details: Scout and train emerging riders, including youth and U23 development paths. Use youth races to build talent from the very beginning.

replay.title: Dynamic stage replay
replay.description: Follow the race action as it unfolds.
replay.details: Follow each stage through a dynamic replay, not just its finishing order. Watch the race evolve through attacks, changes in position and rider performance.

progression.title: Season-long progression
progression.description: Chase promotion, rankings and long-term goals.
progression.details: Build your club over multiple seasons with rankings, league movement and long-term development. Results and management decisions shape what happens next.
